title: How AI is Revolutionizing TV Commercial Production

facts.fact: The page states that a traditional TV commercial's budget started at $5,000 and quickly climbed to $50,000 or more, before AI production.
facts.quote: a budget that started at $5,000 and quickly climbed to $50,000 or more.

facts.fact: The page states that traditional TV commercial production takes a minimum of 6-12 weeks in total.
The page lists entry-level traditional TV commercial production at $5,000-$10,000, described as basic production with limited options.
The page lists professional-grade traditional TV commercial production at $20,000-$50,000, described as standard national quality.
The page lists premium traditional TV commercial production at $100,000 or more, for high-end creative, celebrities, and complex shoots.
The page states that each revision round in traditional TV commercial production costs $500-$5,000.
The page claims AI-powered TV commercial production takes 2-5 minutes (vendor's own claim).
The page claims that AI-generated TV commercial production is free, with the advertiser paying only to run the ad (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: Cost: Free (you only pay to run the ad)

facts.fact: The page claims that AI revisions are free because new versions can be generated instantly (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: Revision cost: Free (generate new versions instantly)

facts.fact: The page's vendor claims that a small business with $50 and a website can have a professional TV commercial running on major streaming channels.
facts.quote: If you have $50 and a website, you can have a professional TV commercial running on major streaming channels.

facts.fact: The page gives a traditional concept development phase of 1-2 weeks with a creative agency.
facts.quote: Concept development:** 1-2 weeks with creative agency

facts.fact: The page gives a traditional script writing and approval phase of 1-2 weeks.
